original_title: Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis End-of-Service Announced for October 6th
summary_en: Square Enix has announced the end of service for the mobile RPG Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis. The game will cease operations on October 6th, 2026, bringing a close to its reimagining of the FFVII saga.
ai_analysis: The swift closure of Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis highlights the challenges of sustaining long-term engagement in the mobile gacha space, even for beloved IPs.

en.title: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis Shutting Down October 6th, 2026
en.summary: Square Enix has announced the end of service for the mobile RPG Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis. The game will cease operations on October 6th, 2026, bringing a close to its reimagining of the FFVII saga.
en.body:
The world of **Final Fantasy VII** is about to lose another piece of its expanded universe. Square Enix has officially announced that **Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis** will be ending its service on October 6th, 2026. This news comes as a disappointment to many players who have been enjoying the mobile gacha title that aimed to bring the entirety of the **Final Fantasy VII** saga, including the original game, **Crisis Core**, and other related stories, into one cohesive experience with a charming, updated visual style.

Launched initially on iOS and Android in September 2023, with a PC release following in December 2023, **Ever Crisis** offered a unique way to relive iconic moments and explore new narratives within the **Compilation of Final Fantasy VII**. The game managed to garner significant attention, even reaching 7 million downloads before its PC debut. However, the decision to end service, as stated by Square Enix, comes after careful consideration, with the company finding it difficult to maintain the quality of experience players expect.

> "We understand that this news may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for the abrupt nature of this announcement," wrote Square Enix as part of its announcement. "Since the launch of the App Store and Google Play versions on September 7, 2023, and the Steam version on December 6, 2023, we have worked to provide the best possible experience for our players. After careful consideration, however, we have determined that it will be difficult to continue doing so and have made the decision to end service."

## The End of an Era for a Mobile Compendium

For fans of **Final Fantasy VII**, **Ever Crisis** represented a ambitious project to consolidate the sprawling narrative of their favorite characters and worlds. It allowed both long-time followers and newcomers to experience Cloud Strife's journey, Zack Fair's adventures, and more, all within a single, accessible platform. The game's gacha mechanics, while a staple of the mobile genre, also meant that player investment was tied to ongoing development and new content. The announcement of its shutdown suggests that these elements may not have met Square Enix's long-term goals for the title, or that the operational costs have become prohibitive.

## What This Means for Players

As of the announcement, players will no longer be able to purchase Red Crystals, the game's premium currency. However, all existing Red Crystals can be spent until the servers go offline. Planned in-game events will continue as scheduled until October 6th, 2026, giving players a final few months to enjoy the content. Square Enix has also confirmed that personal and account information will be deleted post-service, and players in Taiwan will be eligible for refunds on unused in-game currency, with further details to be released on the official website. The abruptness of the announcement has understandably left many players feeling disheartened, especially those who had invested significant time and resources into their accounts.

## Looking Ahead

With the end of service set for October 6th, 2026, players have a clear timeframe to conclude their adventures in **Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis**. While this chapter closes, the enduring legacy of **Final Fantasy VII** continues with other ongoing projects and the upcoming **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth**, ensuring that the beloved universe remains vibrant for fans.

tr.title: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis 6 Ekim 2026'da Kapanıyor
tr.summary: Square Enix, mobil RPG Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis'in hizmetinin 6 Ekim 2026'da sonlandırılacağını duyurdu. Bu haber, FFVII saga'sının yeniden hayal edilen world'ünü deneyimleyen oyuncular için bir hayal kırıklığı oldu.
tr.body:
## Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis'in Sonu
Final Fantasy VII world'ü, genişletilmiş evreninden bir başka parçayı kaybetmek üzere. Square Enix, resmi olarak Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis'in 6 Ekim 2026'da hizmetinin sonlandırılacağını açıkladı. Bu haber, mobil gacha başlıklarını seven ve FFVII saga'sının tamamını, orijinal oyunu, Crisis Core'u ve diğer ilgili hikayeleri bir araya getirmeyi hedefleyen oyuncular için bir hayal kırıklığı oldu.

Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis, ilk olarak Eylül 2023'te iOS ve Android için piyasaya sürülmüş, Aralık 2023'te PC sürümü çıkarmıştı. **Ever Crisis**, ikonik anları yeniden yaşamak ve **Compilation of Final Fantasy VII** içinde yeni hikayeler keşfetmek için benzersiz bir yol sunuyordu. Oyun, 7 milyon indirme sayısına ulaşmış, ancak Square Enix, hizmetin sonlandırılması kararını, oyuncuların beklediği kaliteyi sürdüremeyeceği gerekçesiyle aldı.

> "Bu haberlerin oyuncularımız için hayal kırıklığı yaratabileceğini anlıyor ve bu sudden açıklamanın abruptluğundan dolayı özür dileriz" dedi Square Enix, açıklamasında. "7 Eylül 2023'te App Store ve Google Play sürümlerinin ve 6 Aralık 2023'te Steam sürümünün piyasaya sürülmesinden bu yana, oyuncularımıza mümkün olan en iyi deneyimi sunmaya çalıştık. Ancak dikkatli bir değerlendirme sonrasında, bunu sürdürmenin zor olacağına karar verdik ve hizmetin sonlandırılmasına karar verdik."

## Bir Mobil Ansiklopedinin Sonu
Final Fantasy VII hayranları için **Ever Crisis**, favori karakterlerin ve world'lerinin genişletilmiş hikayesini bir araya getirmeyi hedefleyen bir proje olarak görülüyordu. Bu, hem uzun süredir takip eden hem de yeni oyuncuların Cloud Strife'in yolculuğunu, Zack Fair'in maceralarını ve daha fazlasını tek bir platformda deneyimlemelerine olanak tanıyordu. Oyunun gacha mekanikleri, mobil oyunların bir standardı olmakla birlikte, oyuncuların yatırımının devam eden geliştirme ve yeni içeriğe bağlı olduğu anlamına geliyordu. Hizmetin sonlandırılması, bu öğelerin Square Enix'in oyun için uzun vadeli hedeflerine ulaşamadığını veya operasyonel maliyetlerin prohibitive hale geldiğini gösteriyor.

## Oyuncular için Ne Anlama Geliyor
Açıklamanın yapıldığı tarihten itibaren, oyuncular artık Red Crystals, yani oyunun premium para birimi satın alamayacak. Ancak mevcut Red Crystals, sunucular kapandığında kadar harcanabilecek. Planlanan in-game etkinlikler, 6 Ekim 2026'ya kadar devam edecek, böylece oyuncular son birkaç ayda içeriği deneyimleme fırsatı bulacak. Square Enix, ayrıca kişisel ve hesap bilgilerinin hizmet sonlandırıldıktan sonra silineceğini ve Taiwan'daki oyuncuların kullanılmayan in-game para birimi için geri ödemeye hak kazanacağını onayladı, ayrıntılı bilgiler resmi web sitesinden paylaşılacak. Açıklamanın suddenluğu, özellikle hesabına önemli zaman ve kaynak ayırmış oyuncuların hayal kırıklığına uğramasına neden oldu.

## Gelecek
Hizmetin sonlandırılması 6 Ekim 2026'da gerçekleşecek. Oyuncular, **Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis**'teki maceralarını tamamlamak için net bir zaman çizelgesine sahip. Bu bölüm kapanırken, **Final Fantasy VII**'nin kalıcı mirası, devam eden projelerle ve yaklaşan **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth** ile birlikte, sevilen evrenin hayranları için canlı kalacak.

es.title: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis cierra sus puertas el 6 de octubre de 2026
es.summary: Square Enix ha anunciado el fin del servicio para el RPG móvil Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis. El juego dejará de funcionar el 6 de octubre de 2026, poniendo fin a su reimaginación de la saga de FFVII. Los jugadores tienen un plazo claro para concluir sus aventuras en este título que prometió una experiencia única en el universo de Final Fantasy VII.
es.body:
El mundo de **Final Fantasy VII** está a punto de perder otra pieza de su universo expandido. Square Enix ha anunciado oficialmente que **Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis** finalizará su servicio el 6 de octubre de 2026. Esta noticia llega como una decepción para muchos jugadores que han disfrutado del título de gacha móvil que buscaba reunir toda la saga de **Final Fantasy VII**, incluyendo el juego original, **Crisis Core** y otras historias relacionadas, en una experiencia cohesiva con un estilo visual actualizado y encantador.

Lanzado inicialmente en iOS y Android en septiembre de 2023, y posteriormente en PC en diciembre de 2023, **Ever Crisis** ofreció una forma única de revivir momentos icónicos y explorar nuevas narrativas dentro de la **Compilación de Final Fantasy VII**. El juego logró captar una atención significativa, incluso alcanzando 7 millones de descargas antes de su debut en PC. Sin embargo, la decisión de finalizar el servicio, según Square Enix, se tomó después de una cuidadosa consideración, ya que la empresa encontró difícil mantener la calidad de experiencia que los jugadores esperan.

> "Entendemos que esta noticia puede ser decepcionante, y nos disculpamos sinceramente por la naturaleza abrupta de este anuncio," escribió Square Enix como parte de su anuncio. "Desde el lanzamiento de las versiones de la App Store y Google Play el 7 de septiembre de 2023, y la versión de Steam el 6 de diciembre de 2023, hemos trabajado para proporcionar la mejor experiencia posible para nuestros jugadores. Después de una cuidadosa consideración, sin embargo, hemos determinado que será difícil continuar haciéndolo y hemos tomado la decisión de finalizar el servicio."

## El fin de una era para un compendio móvil

Para los fanáticos de **Final Fantasy VII**, **Ever Crisis** representó un proyecto ambicioso para consolidar la narrativa expansiva de sus personajes y mundos favoritos. Permitió a seguidores de larga data y nuevos jugadores experimentar el viaje de Cloud Strife, las aventuras de Zack Fair y más, todo dentro de una plataforma única y accesible. Los mecanismos de gacha del juego, aunque un elemento estándar del género móvil, también significaban que la inversión del jugador estaba ligada al desarrollo continuo y al nuevo contenido. El anuncio de su cierre sugiere que estos elementos pueden no haber cumplido con los objetivos a largo plazo de Square Enix para el título, o que los costos operativos se han vuelto prohibitivos.

## ¿Qué significa esto para los jugadores?

A partir del anuncio, los jugadores ya no podrán comprar Cristales Rojos, la moneda premium del juego. Sin embargo, todos los Cristales Rojos existentes se pueden gastar hasta que los servidores se apaguen. Los eventos planificados en el juego continuarán según lo programado hasta el 6 de octubre de 2026, dando a los jugadores unos meses finales para disfrutar del contenido. Square Enix también ha confirmado que la información personal y de la cuenta se eliminará después del servicio, y los jugadores en Taiwán serán elegibles para reembolsos de la moneda del juego no utilizada, con más detalles que se lanzarán en el sitio web oficial. La abruptez del anuncio ha dejado a muchos jugadores desanimados, especialmente aquellos que habían invertido tiempo y recursos significativos en sus cuentas.

## Mirando hacia adelante

Con el fin del servicio establecido para el 6 de octubre de 2026, los jugadores tienen un marco de tiempo claro para concluir sus aventuras en **Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis**. Mientras que este capítulo cierra, el legado duradero de **Final Fantasy VII** continúa con otros proyectos en curso y el próximo **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth**, asegurando que el universo querido permanezca vibrante para los fanáticos.

content_raw: Square Enix has announced that it is ending support for Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis on October 6th. Leading up to the game’s servers being taken down, players will no longer be able to purchase any Red Crystals from the in-game store. However, they will be free to spend all the Red Crystals that they might have until the servers are taken down. In the meantime, planned in-game events will continue until October 6th. Square Enix has also said that it plans to delete all of the personal and account information it has from its players once the end-of-service process has been completed. Players residing in Taiwan will also be eligible for refunds on unused in-game currency. More details about these refunds will be revealed on the game’s official website at a later date. Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis was originally released on Android and iOS in September 2023 and on PC in December 2023 . The title was meant to be a way for players to experience iconic moments from the original release of Final Fantasy 7 and its prequel spin-off, Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 , in a new visual style. “We understand that this news may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for the abrupt nature of this announcement,” wrote Square Enix as part of its announcement. “Since the launch of the App Store and Google Play versions on September 7, 2023, and the Steam version on December 6, 2023, we have worked to provide the best possible experience for our players. After careful consideration, however, we have determined that it will be difficult to continue doing so and have made the decision to end service.” When it first came out, Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis saw quite a bit of success, with Square Enix confirming that the title had been downloaded 7 million times before even coming out on PC. At the time, it decided to reward players for their interest in the game by giving out a thousand Blue Crystals. In terms of gameplay, Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis featured a fast-paced command-based combat system based on the Active Time Battle system from the original Final Fantasy 7 . Players could make use of classic elements, including unique abilities, Materia, summons, and Limit Breaks. In the meantime, Square Enix is working on wrapping up its Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy with the release of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation in Spring 2027.
